title: DC-area forecast: Heat is back for now. Shower chances return Thursday into Thursday night.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Clouds increase a bit after midnight and toward dawn as lows settle in the upper 60s to mid-70s. A shower is possible by morning.

What’s next? More humid tomorrow with a few daytime showers, then scattered showers and storms possible at night. Friday trends dry and a bit cooler. Some showers and a storm are possible Saturday.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Skies stay mostly clear as we hang on to a breeze from the south and southwest. Humidity creeps a bit higher with lows in the upper 60s to mid-70s. Confidence: High

Tomorrow (Thursday): Partly sunny with highs in the mid-80s to near 90. Higher humidity (dew points in the mid-60s to near 70) push the heat index deep into the 90s. A few showers come through during the morning hours, then an isolated shower or storm possible during the afternoon. Confidence: Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow night: Mostly cloudy and rather muggy as the chance for scattered showers and storms rises during the evening and especially overnight As a cold front moves in from the northwest. Lows in the upper 60s to near 70. Confidence: Low-Medium

Help sustain an independent Capital Weather by becoming a free or paid supporter. Learn more at capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Friday starts mostly cloudy with maybe a lingering morning shower and still on the humid side. But skies should brighten some by afternoon as the cold front pushes farther away to our south, and humidity may start to come down as well. Cooler highs top out in the upper 70s to low 80s. Partly cloudy Friday night with lows in the 60s. Confidence: Medium

Partly to mostly cloudy Saturday with some showers and a thunderstorm possible at some point Saturday into Saturday night. Daytime highs reach the mid-70s to low 80s as humidity trends back higher again. Saturday night lows settle in the mid-60s to low 70s. Confidence: Low

We may hang on to the chance of an isolated shower or storm on Sunday, when skies should be partly sunny with highs in the upper 70s to mid-80s. Confidence: Low-Medium

DC weather history for September 9

A 2018 rainstorm set a daily record and contributed to one of the wettest years on record, with an unusually high number of days topping an inch of rainfall.

Today’s daily digit — 6/10: Some spots have a shot at 90 degrees. But September heat isn't as harsh as midsummer, and humidity is still relatively tame. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.
